question.text: 'Surya Growth Fund' is an ordinary scheme of a Category I AIF (other than an Angel Fund). What is the maximum number of investors this scheme can have under SEBI (AIF) Regulations?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the current SEBI (AIF) framework, ordinary AIF schemes may have up to 1000 investors per scheme. The 200-investor cap is the company-law private-placement limit and is not the AIF scheme cap. The Trap: 200 is the company private-placement limit, not the AIF scheme cap. 49 relates to other private-placement sub-limits. 'Unlimited' is wrong — AIF schemes are subject to the 1000-investor cap. Note: Per the 2025 framework, Angel Funds shall not launch schemes, so the scheme-investor cap question applies to ordinary (non-Angel) AIF schemes.
